data.title: 塔露拉 · 温泉旅馆私人汤池微雾岩石畔的缠绵相依
data.description: 日式温泉度假旅馆的私人庭院木桶汤池内，水汽在竹影间袅袅升腾。塔露拉褪尽衣物半浸在温热的泉水中，双臂轻搭在桧木池沿上。水珠顺着微湿的银灰长发滑落光洁玉背，她回首望向身侧靠近的你，金瞳中泛着水雾与娇羞，龙尾在温水中轻轻缠上你的脚踝。
data.location: 日式温泉旅馆私人庭院露天木桶汤池边
data.action: 双臂搭在木桶池沿，湿身回眸，水雾缭绕中龙尾轻缠
data.lighting: 庭院石灯笼的暖黄烛光与温润水气反射
data.promptProse: Half-submerged in a private outdoor cedar hot-spring tub ringed by dark garden bamboo at night, Talulah rests both bare arms along the warm wet rim. Water droplets trickle down her glistening bare back and curved waist as she looks back over her shoulder with flushed cheeks and parted wet lips, her slender tail curling beneath the steaming surface. Warm amber light from a stone garden lantern glows softly through the rising mist.
data.animaCaption: Soaking completely nude in the steaming cedar onsen tub with both arms resting on the rim, Talulah looks back over her glistening bare shoulder with flushed cheeks and parted lips. Warm stone-lantern light drifts through the night mist and dark bamboo.
